sampling.rule: Fixed 3:1 previously-passing to previously-failing ratio, plus 26 incident-derived placeholders while source incident state is unavailable in this worktree.

holdOut.promptIsolation: Manifest lives under shared/fixtures/harness-replay, outside .wavemill/evals and outside runtime prompt/resource discovery paths. Cases are consumed only by tools/run-harness-replay.ts or direct replay tests.
holdOut.refreshPolicy: Refresh every six months; retire cases with no regression signal for six months only after replacing them with newer stable cases at the same pass/fail ratio.

stability.evidence: Synthetic sanitized seed is deterministic under injected adapters. Historic stability probe must be rerun when real artifacts are restored.

incidents.evidence: Routing/review replay captures unexpected check reruns against parked merge-lane PR evidence.
Eval judging replay includes stored challenge identity fields and fails when candidate output drifts.
Cheap decision replay does not execute integration-only monitor bundle regeneration; retain as workflow-replay gap.
